meta.title: Prosecution Request Estimator
meta.description: Choose a crime and the circumstances of the case to see, based on how investigative agencies usually handle such cases, the likely handling step (suspension of indictment, summary fine, formal trial, detention) and the sentence or fine the prosecutor may request.
meta.lead: Choose a crime and answer a few questions to see the likely handling step and the requested sentence (the penalty the prosecutor asks the court to impose at trial) or fine.
meta.notice: This is only an estimate based on how investigative agencies usually handle cases. The actual decision and request depend on the facts of the case, such as a settlement, prior convictions and how the crime happened, and on the judgment of the prosecutor in charge; the final sentence is decided by the court. If you are about to be questioned, do not rely on this result alone and talk to a lawyer first.

family-court.label: Referral to the Family Court possible
family-court.desc: Domestic or juvenile protection case: instead of criminal punishment, the Family Court imposes protective dispositions such as counseling, a no-contact order or community service

suspension.label: Suspension of indictment possible
suspension.desc: Suspension of indictment (기소유예): the wrongdoing is recognized, but the prosecutor takes various circumstances into account and closes the case without sending it to trial

summary.label: Summary fine
summary.desc: Summary indictment (약식기소): a procedure in which a fine is set on the documents, without a trial in a courtroom

trial.label: Formal trial
trial.desc: Formal trial (구공판): the prosecutor asks the court for a trial, and you stand before a judge in a courtroom

detention.label: Detention considered
detention.desc: Detention (구속): being held in custody during the investigation and trial under a court warrant when there is a risk of fleeing or destroying evidence

levels.family-court: Referral to the Family Court possible

browser.preparing: We are preparing the list of crimes. If it is urgent, send us a message first.
browser.searchPlaceholder: Search crimes, laws or articles (e.g. fraud)
browser.noMatch: No matching crime. Try other words, or send us a message.

form.loadError: We could not load the crime information. Please try again or refresh the page.
form.noResult: There is no estimate for this combination. Please send us a message.
form.progress: Answer all {total} questions and the estimate appears right away. ({done}/{total})

result.heading: Likely handling
result.barLabel: Step {n} of the five handling steps: {label}
result.noPenaltySuspension: The case may end without being sent to trial.
result.noPenaltyFamilyCourt: The case may move to a Family Court procedure instead of a criminal trial.
result.disclaimer: This is only an estimate based on how investigative agencies usually handle cases. The actual decision and request depend on the facts of the case and the judgment of the prosecutor in charge. The final sentence is decided by the court.
result.refLead: There is no separate standard for estimating the prosecutor's request for this crime. Please check the Sentence Estimator.
result.consultOnlyLead: There is no set standard for the prosecutor's request for this crime. Depending on the facts, not only the request but also the applicable statutory penalty may differ, so please ask a lawyer.

intl.otherCrimes: The English version only covers crimes that often come up in cases involving foreign nationals. For crimes not listed here, please send us a message.
